pg006_n0005: This textbook is the Third Edition, improved from the Second Edition of 2021 of the English Pupil’s Book Standard Three, published by TIE in accordance with the 2016 Basic Education Syllabus for Standard III.
pg006_n0007: The book is aimed at enabling the pupil to develop competencies in listening, speaking, reading and writing in English.
pg006_n0009: Each unit contains oral and writing activities that are systematically organised to enable the pupil to practise and acquire the intended competencies.

pg013_n0005: Then, answer orally the questions that follow.
pg013_n0008: A trip to the Serengeti National Park
pg013_n0012: Mrs Mashaka is our Geography and the Environment teacher.
pg013_n0013: One day, she taught us about the national parks in Tanzania.
pg013_n0014: She said, “The Serengeti is among the largest national parks in the country.
pg013_n0015: It has many animals, birds and insects.”
pg013_n0016: She asked, “How many of you have been to the Serengeti?”
pg013_n0018: The teacher asked again, “Would you like to visit the Serengeti?”
pg014_n0003: A week later, Mrs Mashaka took our class to the Serengeti National Park.
pg014_n0004: When we were in the park, she asked us to write the names of the animals, birds and insects that we saw.
pg014_n0005: She divided us into three groups.
pg014_n0006: The first group was asked to write the names of animals.
pg014_n0007: The second group was asked to write the names of birds.
pg014_n0008: The third group was asked to write the names of insects.
pg014_n0011: We went back to school and reported what we had seen.
pg014_n0012: The animals were lions, elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, antelopes and monkeys.
pg014_n0013: The birds were eagles, ostriches, flamingos, crows, woodpeckers and many others.
pg014_n0014: The insects included bees, wasps, grasshoppers, ants, tsetse flies and butterflies.
pg014_n0020: What subject does Mrs Mashaka teach?
pg014_n0023: What was the first group asked to do?
pg014_n0026: What was the second group asked to do?
pg014_n0029: What was the third group asked to do?

pg069_n0045: Do you know what a hen is?
pg069_n0048: A hen is a female chicken that lays eggs.
pg070_n0004: Many features help the hen to survive and care for its chicks.
pg070_n0007: One of these features is its sharp beak.
pg070_n0010: It uses the beak to eat, drink and peck.
pg070_n0016: It can crack seeds, nuts and even small shells.
pg070_n0019: The hen also uses its beak for defence against predators.
pg070_n0022: Examples of predators are foxes, hawks and snakes.
pg070_n0025: The hen can cause pain and injury to the attacker.
pg070_n0028: This tool helps the hen live a happy and healthy life.
